observations: Black manual sewing machine head with gold-colored decorative decals.
The machine is mounted on a wooden cabinet with a dark wood-grain top and light-colored body.
A treadle mechanism including a foot pedal and a large drive wheel is visible inside the cabinet.
A leather drive belt connects the lower wheel to the machine head.
The cabinet has a folding top and a side door with two small storage compartments containing sewing supplies.
A pink measuring tape and a spool of black thread are on the machine.
The background shows a Mouka Flora branded mattress and tiled flooring.

identity.kind: manual sewing machine with treadle cabinet

claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean in photos, but internal mechanical cleanliness and condition are unknown.
There are no visible 'Made in UK' stamps or import markings to confirm origin.
Photo 0 shows the treadle pedal and hand-operated wheel characteristic of manual machines.
The design is a standard domestic/home sewing machine, not a high-speed industrial unit.

risks.risk: The machine may be mechanically seized or have incorrect timing, preventing it from sewing.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine successfully sewing a line of stitches through two layers of fabric.

risks.risk: Essential internal components like the bobbin case or shuttle may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the machine head or the open bobbin compartment.

risks.risk: The wooden cabinet may have hidden structural damage, rot, or failing hinges.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cabinet base, hinges, and the underside of the folding top.

proof_requests: A video of the machine in operation sewing fabric.
A clear photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate open.
A clear, close-up photo of the brand name and logo on the machine arm and front plate.
Photos of the cabinet's rear and base to check for wood damage.
response.reason: The item is identified as a domestic manual sewing machine with a treadle cabinet. It can be priced at its worst-case (non-functional) value, with the brand treated as generic since it is not clearly legible in the provided photos.
